title: Longest Idle Period
scenario: Find the longest gap (in days) between the end date of one project and the start date of the next project for the company. Return 'max_idle_days'.
tableSchema: projects (project_id INT, start_date DATE, end_date DATE, budget INT)
hint: Sort by date, find the gap between current start_date and previous end_date.
correctQuery: SELECT MAX(start_date - prev_end) AS max_idle_days FROM (SELECT start_date, LAG(end_date) OVER(ORDER BY start_date) AS prev_end FROM projects) t;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE projects (project_id INT, start_date DATE, end_date DATE, budget INT); INSERT INTO projects VALUES (1, '2026-01-01', '2026-02-01', 1000), (2, '2026-03-01', '2026-04-01', 1000);
